title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
snippet: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.

title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
snippet: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
snippet: The tiny hardware device creates  another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.
